title: TabularDA
summary: TabularDA is a research toolkit implementing and comparing multiple synthetic tabular-data generation methods (naive Bayes, PCA-GMM, Bayesian networks, and deep generative models) for data augmentation experiments. Its synthesizer.py directly instantiates SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer via sdv.single_table, builds a SingleTableMetadata schema, and evaluates outputs with sdmetrics' QualityReport, making SDV one of several synthesis backends actually run.
